page_title: HOL 0-2 WOL | Holstein Kiel v Wolfsburg 31/08/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+10' That's the end of the match.
90+9' Max Geschwill (Holstein Kiel) makes a really bad tackle on his opponent and is relieved when the referee only shows him a yellow card.
90+7' Referee Florian Exner has finally had enough of Marcel Rapp and gives him a straight RED CARD!
90+7' Jann-Fiete Arp (Holstein Kiel) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
90+6' The attendance is 15034.
90+5' Holstein Kiel have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
90+4' Kamil Grabara makes a superb save to deny a header which was nodded towards the top left corner by Benedikt Pichler (Holstein Kiel) after a cross from the side.
90+3' Jakub Kaminski (Wolfsburg) tries a pot shot from the edge of the box, but it goes narrowly wide of the left post.
90+1' Nicolai Remberg (Holstein Kiel) is caught offside, but it was a really close call.
90' 7 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
89' Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg) is cautioned by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
86' Here comes a substitution. Lasse Rosenboom (Holstein Kiel) is brought on as a substitute for Lewis Holtby.
80' Here is a change. Ridle Baku is going off and Ralph Hasenhuttl gives the last tactical orders to Bence Dardai (Wolfsburg).
80' The referee signals a substitution. Yannick Gerhardt (Wolfsburg) is brought on as a substitute for Tiago Tomas.
80' Jann-Fiete Arp (Holstein Kiel) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
79' The free kick from a promising distance is taken by Armin Gigovic (Holstein Kiel), who fires in a direct effort just wide of the left post. What a chance!
78' Jann-Fiete Arp (Holstein Kiel) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
77' Cedric Zesiger (Wolfsburg) has tested the patience of referee Florian Exner and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
75' Marcel Rapp decides to make a substitution. Magnus Knudsen will be replaced by Nicolai Remberg (Holstein Kiel).
74' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Mattias Svanberg trots off the pitch and is replaced by Jonas Wind (Wolfsburg).
73' Shuto Machino (Holstein Kiel) takes a wonderful touch after collecting a pass inside the box. He steers his low drive towards the left post, but the keeper dives low to keep the ball out.
71' The ball goes out of play and it will be a corner kick.
70' Jann-Fiete Arp (Holstein Kiel) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
65' Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg) whips in a cross from the corner, but Timon Weiner is well positioned and punches the ball away.

65' Patrick Wimmer (Wolfsburg) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender. The referee points to the corner flag and Wolfsburg will take a corner.
63' Marcel Rapp prepares a substitution. Finn Porath is replaced by Armin Gigovic (Holstein Kiel).
63' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Alexander Bernhardsson as he is replaced by Jann-Fiete Arp (Holstein Kiel).

63' Timon Weiner makes a brilliant save! Mattias Svanberg (Wolfsburg) easily weaves through the defence and unleashes a shot from just outside of the box. His effort goes towards the bottom left corner but is saved by the keeper!
58' Magnus Knudsen (Holstein Kiel) makes a bad challenge and receives a yellow card. The referee had no doubt.
58' 48:52 – this is the current ball possession ratio.
51' Tiago Tomas (Wolfsburg) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Florian Exner had an easy-decision to make.
48' Alexander Bernhardsson (Holstein Kiel) goes into the book for a horrible tackle. A yellow card is necessary in this case.
48' Jann-Fiete Arp (Holstein Kiel) is given a yellow card.
48' Mattias Svanberg (Wolfsburg) meets a cross and produces a header towards the bottom left corner, but one of the defending players blocks the effort.
48' The ball goes behind for a corner. Wolfsburg will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
46' Marcel Rapp has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Max Geschwill (Holstein Kiel) comes on the pitch for Marco Komenda.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+4' Florian Exner blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+4' The corner from Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg) is intercepted by the defence.

45+3' Wolfsburg take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Wolfsburg will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
45+2' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Ridle Baku (Wolfsburg). Wolfsburg force a corner. They send men into the box.
45+1' Lovro Majer is being substituted because of an injury. Ralph Hasenhuttl sends Salih Ozcan (Wolfsburg) on the pitch.
45+1' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.
44' Lovro Majer (Wolfsburg) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
43' What was Kilian Fischer (Wolfsburg) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
42' Close! A mistake by a defender gifts Timo Becker (Holstein Kiel) a chance inside the box, but his efforts curls just around the left post.
41' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Ridle Baku (Wolfsburg) was quite harsh and Florian Exner didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
41' Lovro Majer (Wolfsburg) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety.
40' Tiago Tomas (Wolfsburg) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. Wolfsburg will take a corner kick.
37' A poor attempt from the edge of the box. Marco Komenda (Holstein Kiel) dragged a first-time shot well wide of the right post.
37' Benedikt Pichler (Holstein Kiel) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
36' Benedikt Pichler (Holstein Kiel) picks up an injury.
35' Patrick Wimmer (Wolfsburg) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.

30' 0 - 2 Sebastiaan Bornauw (Wolfsburg) celebrates a stunning goal. He manages to win himself just enough space inside the box to meet the free kick and powers a perfectly placed header low inside the right post.
27' 0 - 1 Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg) can showcase his brilliant free kick ability, particularly from a distance like this. He hits the ball perfectly and it ends up in the roof of the net.
26' Finn Porath (Holstein Kiel) jumps into a tackle and Florian Exner signals a foul. Wolfsburg have a free kick.
25' The corner is swung in but Wolfsburg can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
24' Patrick Wimmer (Wolfsburg) drives a shot towards the bottom right corner from inside the box, but Timon Weiner leaps like a salmon and knocks the ball away.

21' A nice sequence of play ends with a shot by Alexander Bernhardsson (Holstein Kiel) from the edge of the box. The effort, however, is towards the middle of the goal where Kamil Grabara easily catches the ball.
19' Mattias Svanberg (Wolfsburg) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
16' The keeper doesn't have to worry about this one. Alexander Bernhardsson (Holstein Kiel) sacrificed accuracy for power, and thus his attempt went well over the bar.
16' Tiago Tomas (Wolfsburg) sends a cross into the box, but Timon Weiner comes off his line to gather the ball.

12' What a chance that is! Shuto Machino (Holstein Kiel) finds himself unmarked in a promising position after receiving a cross on the edge of the box and his attempt sails a whisker wide of the left post.
11' Shuto Machino (Holstein Kiel) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.

8' Marco Komenda (Holstein Kiel) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Florian Exner stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning. Free kick. Wolfsburg will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
8' Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg) is able to continue to play.
7' Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
6' Alexander Bernhardsson (Holstein Kiel) put a cross into the box which wasn't a bad decision, but he failed to achieve what he wanted as none of his teammates managed to meet it.
1' The match has just started.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Wolfsburg will have the kick-off.
